records.rule_name: Stair finish-level method, owner preference ranges as checks, and design scenarios for undefined stairs

inputs.ffl_bottom / ffl_top: finished floor levels; the riser basis is FFL to FFL (S-3, unchanged)
inputs.F0 / F1: finishing build-up above the structural slab at the lower / upper floor, from the drawings or approved details; otherwise HELD (never 10 cm, never 0)
inputs.S_i: finish above structural tread / landing i, from the drawings or approved details; UP-STAIR-006 (0.030 m tread finish unless drawing / specification / owner) is unchanged
inputs.surfaces: drawn treads and landings in the order of ascent; goings and landing footprints derived from each flight configuration

calculation_method: 1 intended finished riser R = (FFL_top - FFL_bottom) / risers, uniform

2 concrete level under a surface = its finished level - its finish; riser i concrete = R + S(i-1) - S(i); first = R + F0 - S1; last = R + S(last tread) - F1 (sign convention checked by the main chat, section 2)
3 never hardcode 25 / 15 / 5 or 26 / 16 / 6; never assume equal floor and stair finishes
4 count actual goings per flight from the drawn tread surfaces, never risers minus one unless the configuration demonstrates it; a landing is never a going and its footprint is its drawn polygon

5 checks on a drawn stair: finished riser 150 - 170 mm, going 280 - 300 mm (owner preferences, not defaults, not mandatory requirements); a value outside is a finding, never a change (S-8, UP-STAIR-002)

6 undrawn or insufficiently defined stair (S-4 C, S-5): evaluate riser counts in 150 - 170 and continuous going intervals in 280 - 300 (S-6), eliminate by FFL rise, available run (FIXED / MAXIMUM; RUN_TYPE_UNKNOWN gives scenarios only), stairwell, landings, headroom and verified requirements; present remaining alternatives; never auto-select; affected BOQ quantities HELD; 0.16 / 0.30 only as a labelled illustrative scenario
7 no generated winders, no assumed off-axis offset (S-9); drawn and dimensioned winders measured from their geometry, otherwise HELD / UNSUPPORTED

8 BOQ quantities (concrete, bars, formwork, marble treads / risers m2 and pieces, landing marble, nosing, rail along the slope by side) from ONE stair geometry, each released on its own evidence; HELD = blank; scenario ranges in a separate report
boq_outputs: per-riser finished / structural levels and heights, each HELD where a finish is unknown
per-flight riser and going counts with the configuration evidence
findings PROJECTION, MISALIGNED_TOP, EXTRA_OR_MISSING_STEP, LANDING_DEPTH, HEADROOM, ARCH_STRUCT_DISAGREE, OUTSIDE_OWNER_PREFERENCE
component lines with their own status; a separate design-scenario report

relations.UP-STAIR-002: unchanged: drawn counts govern; the new ranges are checks on drawn stairs
relations.UP-STAIR-015: unchanged in URBAN_RULES 1.6.0; its 0.16 / 0.30 values become an illustrative scenario only for undefined stairs (S-4 point 7); the check limits for drawn stairs are this record's ranges
relations.UP-STAIR-009: unchanged diagnostic range 0.155 - 0.165, not a limit
relations.UP-STAIR-003 / UP-STAIR-006: unchanged: visible riser = riser - build-up of the surface it rises onto; 0.030 m tread finish unless drawing / specification / owner
relations.S-3: unchanged: floor height = FFL to FFL

continuous going intervals, not a grid; alternatives never approved automatically
